# TPM system TP-500

Tire pressure monitoring system, made in China.

<img src="file:///front.png" width="400"/>

## Information

- **Manufacturer**: _Unspecified_
- **Model**: ТР-500 ([Ozon](https://www.ozon.ru/product/tyre-pressure-sensor-527050129))
- **Frequency**: 433.92MHz
- **Sensor type**: Internal (4 pieces)
- **Sensor Triggered factor**: pressure changing only
- **Modulation**: FSK
- **Recived data (example)**: `55555555555555555555555555555555555555 5665 699995a99695959a9655996655569a6a6a5655aaaa6a55`
- **Encoded**: Manchester (G.E. Thomas) - example `0000000000000000000146a8e988b90a501b7710ff70`
- **Preambule**: 19 bytes
- **Synchronization word**: 2 bytes (0x56, 0x65)

## Packet format

- Y -	Flags (4 bits)
- I - Sensor Identificator (4 bytes)
- P - Pressure p*3 (1 byte):
	- Units: kPa
	- Range: 0..765kPa or 0..7.65bar
	- Example: 10 or 0x0A = 30kPa or 0.3bar
- T - Temperature t-50 (1 byte): ?
	- Units: Fahrenheit
	- Range: -50..205
	- Example: 54 or 0x36 = 37F or 4C 
- N - Tire Number 1..4 (4 bits)
- C - CRC (2 bytes)
	- Algorithm: CRC-16/IBM-3740
		- Poly: 0x1021
		- Init: 0xFFFF
		- CRC bytes order: reverse
		- Example: claculate CRC ff70 for 46a8e988b90a501b7710 via [crccalc.com](https://crccalc.com/?crc=46a8e988b90a501b7710&method=CRC-16/IBM-3740&datatype=1&outtype=1) (click Input as HEX) and get 0x70FF

Format:

`Y IIIIIIII PP TT ???? N ? CCCC`<br/>
`6 a8e988b9 0a 50 1b77 1 0 ff70`
